name: Pembrolizumab Monotherapy (KEYNOTE-048), First-Line Recurrent or Metastatic Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma, PD-L1 CPS at least 1
cyclesNote: until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; alternate schedule 400 mg every 42 days

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
source.textbook: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22nd ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.PD_L1_CPS: at least 1 (CPS >= 1 required for first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy)
biomarkers.note: Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers v2.2026, SYST-A 4 of 7, first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy is limited to tumors that express PD-L1 with a combined positive score (CPS) at least 1 (category 1). The Discussion (MS-56) confirms pembrolizumab alone is a first-line option for PD-L1 positive (CPS >= 1) disease based on KEYNOTE-048; the OS benefit for monotherapy was seen in the CPS >= 20 and CPS >= 1 populations. Combined positive score is assessed by PD-L1 IHC.

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event surveillance for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, dermatologic, endocrine).
Antiemetic prophylaxis not routinely required for single-agent checkpoint inhibitor (minimal emetic risk).
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during pembrolizumab
imaging every 2 to 3 cycles in the recurrent/metastatic setting (Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, SYST-A 1 of 7 general principles)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, Discussion MS-59. Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV flat dose on day 1 every 21 days. Source-stated alternate schedule: 400 mg IV every 42 days (approved across adult indications). Flat milligram dosing (basis flat), not mg/kg. Continue until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
provenance.locator: Discussion MS-59 (pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks; FDA-approved alternate 400 mg every 6 weeks); indication SYST-A 4 of 7 (first-line, CPS >= 1, category 1)
